Select distinct molecule identifiers, compound names, and canonical SMILES for all compounds in document CHEMBL1123859. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
